title: Crüger to Müller, Easter Monday 1620
author: Peter Crüger
summary: Crüger rejects Kepler's theory of straight-line comet paths because it assumes the earth's annual motion, mocks the 'rabid leaps' it implies, and finds the *Astronomia nova* and *Harmonice mundi* hard to follow.

notes.on: a friend to you above all your friends
notes.note: An echo of the proverb *amicus Plato, sed magis amica veritas*: Plato is a friend, but truth a greater one.
